description: This file defines the interface for overlay loading functionalities, including functions to gather overlay files and apply overlays to a database, specifically in the context of serializing or deserializing overlays in JSON format.

methods.name: gatherOverlays
methods.description: Collects JSON overlay files (*.json) from a specified directory, returning their paths as a vector.

methods.name: applyOverlays
methods.description: Processes a list of overlay file paths, parsing each as JSON and merging with an existing database.
